mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and deceleration in job growth (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand for residential construction, which precedes a slowdown in economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the prior month signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (RSAFS) falls below 0.3% on a month-over-month basis, it indicates weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS growth < 0.3% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signals the onset of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases real borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS change < 0.05pp over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-shock recovery periods when UNRATE declines.
